## Intention

## Libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("readr")
library("here")
library("readxl")
library("knitr")

```

## Run program

Run entire project by running this entire file.

## Code

Only running files if their output file hasn't been created.

```{r}
if (!file.exists(here("data/01_batchCN_array_combined_load.tsv"))) {
  source(purl(here("R/01_load.qmd"),
              output = tempfile(fileext = ".R"),
              quiet = TRUE))
}

```
